HSBC Chief Financial Officer to Leave in 2027
HSBC's group chief financial officer will step down in 2027, the bank said.
Pam Kaur told the group's board of her intention to stand down next year, though the exact date of her departure hasn't been confirmed.
A search for Kaur's successor is under way and both internal and external candidates will be considered, the bank said. Kaur will take on an advisory role to help with succession.
